content.short: Vektor is a DeFi command centre for real-time data, executing transactions and automating workflows across multiple blockchains and protocols.
content.description: Vektor is a comprehensive DeFi command centre that lets investors execute advanced strategies across multiple blockchains and protocols. It streamlines complex operations such as liquidity provisioning, lending and borrowing, and buying or selling assets, all from a single non-custodial interface. By automating repetitive workflows and surfacing real-time on-chain data, Vektor helps manage assets efficiently without requiring extensive in-house engineering across chains like Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Fantom, Moonbeam, ZKsync, Polygon, and Polygon zkEVM.
